description: This Java class 'WriteResultAndErrors' encapsulates the results and errors from a batch write operation to MongoDB, including success, failure, and unexpected error scenarios. It provides static factory methods for creating instances based on different outcomes and contains getters for retrieving stored information.

classes.name: WriteResultAndErrors
classes.description: An immutable data structure representing the outcome of MongoDB bulk write operations, including success, failure, and unexpected error details.

methods.name: success
methods.description: Creates an instance representing a successful bulk write operation with the provided write models and result.

methods.name: failure
methods.description: Creates an instance representing a failed bulk write operation due to a MongoBulkWriteException, including write models and error details.

methods.name: unexpectedError
methods.description: Creates an instance representing an unexpected error during the write operation, including write models and the Throwable error.

methods.name: getWriteModels
methods.description: Returns the list of write models associated with the operation.

methods.name: getBulkWriteResult
methods.description: Returns the result object of the bulk write.

methods.name: getBulkWriteErrors
methods.description: Returns the list of errors encountered during the bulk write.

methods.name: getUnexpectedError
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the Throwable error if an unexpected error occurred.
